verses.1: Let Peter, the servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, help us to hold firm faith in our Lord’s righteousness. May he also be a savior for us, just like Jesus Christ.
verses.2: May grace and peace be upon you, in the knowledge of God and Jesus, our Lord.
verses.3: Whoever has given us all those things that are necessary for life and righteousness, through the recognition of those who called us to this honor and virtue.
verses.4: For we have been given these most precious and great gifts, so that through them you may become true companions in nature, avoiding the desires of this world.
verses.5: And by giving all this attention, they honored your virtues in your faith. And in virtue, they honored your knowledge.
verses.6: And in knowledge, there is patience; in patience, there is humility; and in humility, there is respect.
verses.7: In piety, there is fraternity; in fraternity, there is love.
verses.8: For these things are present and abundant for you. Do not hesitate or be reluctant to sit down in the service of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.9: For these things should not be taken seriously; it’s foolish to try to get rid of the sins that were committed in ancient times.
verses.10: Therefore, brothers, you should always strive to make your prayers and choices more effective. In doing this, never fail to do it with diligence.
verses.11: For in this way, your entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be blessed and rewarding.
verses.12: Therefore, I will always remind you about these matters, so that you may be aware and cautious in the face of true reality.
verses.13: I believe it is just and right, to remind you of this, as long as I am in this position.
verses.14: You know that it’s difficult to give up my possessions, just as our Lord Jesus Christ also said to me.
verses.15: I also hope that every time, you will be able to remember this memory together with me.
verses.16: For it is not by following false myths that we can recognize the power and presence of our Lord Jesus Christ; rather, it is through the greatness of His glory that we can do so.
verses.17: For he received from God the honor and praise of being despised by those who were powerful. My beloved son is this one; I have come to love him very much.
verses.18: And this voice we heard came from heaven, while we were there in the holy mountain.
verses.19: And we will have more certainty regarding the prophetic words. We must take them seriously, treating them as if they were treasures hidden in a secret place. Until that day comes when light shines again and darkness disappears from your hearts.
verses.20: By first understanding this, we realize that not all prophecies written in a uniform style can be fulfilled.
verses.21: For prophecy never came through human will; rather, it was spoken by God through the Holy Spirit to those who prophesied.
